items.title: Enterocytes here are colonocytes: use colon markers
items.text: The list is the small-intestine list. In this sigmoid colon its Enterocytes markers APOB (13%) and MGAM (5%) are hardly detected, while the 3,640 cells carry colonocyte genes: CEACAM7 90%, TMIGD1 89%, AQP8 67% (5-7% of the other epithelial cells). Rename Enterocytes to Colonocytes with CEACAM7+ AQP8+ TMIGD1+ (or start from the built-in colon list) so the type and the colon priors (COL-03) match.

action.request: Propose the marker-list edit: Enterocytes renamed Colonocytes with CEACAM7+ AQP8+ TMIGD1+ BEST4- OTOP2-, checked with check_marker_list.

check.reason: SI markers fail in colon; colonocyte genes are clear and specific.
check.evidence: review_markers v2: APOB 13%, MGAM 5% in Enterocytes; CEACAM7 90% vs 7%, TMIGD1 89% vs 5%, AQP8 67% vs 1%; sample is sigmoid colon (sample_context).

items.title: BEST4+ enterocytes too many (806, only ~106 real)
items.text: Only sub-cluster /1 (106 cells, spatial clustering 2.79) is BEST4+ (BEST4 90%, OTOP2 84%, SPIB 81%, CA4 79%; 10-18% in the rest of the type). The other ~700 cells lack BEST4 (27% overall) and look like CA1+ colonocytes. Require BEST4 together with OTOP2 or CA4 so the type keeps only real BEST4+ cells (COL-03 notes these cells are lost in IBD, so their number matters).

action.request: Propose BEST4+ enterocytes: BEST4+ OTOP2+ CA4+ SPIB+ CCL20-, with the shares above.

check.reason: Only one sub-cluster carries the BEST4 programme.
check.evidence: type_structure BEST4+ enterocytes: /1 106 cells BEST4 90%, OTOP2 84%, CA4 79% vs 10-18% in the other 700; review_markers BEST4 27% overall.

items.title: Eosinophils are LYVE1+ macrophages
items.text: The 118 Eosinophils have no eosinophil transcripts (CLC 0%, CCR3 2%); 70 of them are LYVE1+ (70% vs 15%) and the rest ITGAX+ ACTG2+, i.e. macrophages (confusion with Macrophages 0.30). The panel cannot detect eosinophils: remove the type so these cells return to Macrophages.

action.request: Propose removing Eosinophils from the marker list.

check.reason: No eosinophil transcripts; cells are macrophage-like.
check.evidence: review_markers CLC 0%, CCR3 2%; type_structure /1 LYVE1 70%, /0 ITGAX 60%; type_confusion Macrophages-Eosinophils 0.30; not_found shows CLC in 5 myeloid cells only.

items.title: cDC2 cells are cDC1
items.text: The 100 cells called cDC2 have CLEC9A in 85%, IRF8 in 93 of 99 DCs and CLEC10A in 2%: they are cDC1, which got no cells. Relabel them cDC1 (e.g. drop the CLEC10A- negative from cDC1 or merge cDC2 into Dendritic cells for this sample).

action.request: Propose a marker-list edit so these CLEC9A+ IRF8+ cells become cDC1.

check.reason: The cDC2 cells carry the cDC1 programme, not CLEC10A.
check.evidence: review_markers cDC2: CLEC9A 85%, CLEC10A 2%; DC node: IRF8 in 93 of 99, CLEC9A 85 of 99; cDC1 got 0 cells.

items.title: 764 Unassigned cells are subepithelial telocytes
items.text: The Unassigned cells sit at the epithelium (depth 0) and carry the PDGFRA-hi telocyte programme: POSTN 78%, EDNRB 60%, F3 54%, BMP5 31% (10-20% elsewhere). Telocyte marker BMP5 is weak (17%); add EDNRB or POSTN to PDGFRA-hi telocytes (e.g. F3|BMP5+ EDNRB|POSTN+) so they are typed.

action.request: Propose PDGFRA-hi telocytes markers F3|BMP5+ EDNRB|POSTN+ and check that the Unassigned cells move there.

check.reason: The Unassigned cells share the telocyte genes and sit under the epithelium; the weak BMP5 marker misses them.
check.evidence: review_markers unassigned: POSTN 78% vs 20%, EDNRB 60% vs 10%, F3 54% vs 14%, BMP5 31% vs 4%; spatial_profile Unassigned depth 0, neighbours plasma cells; telocyte BMP5 17%.

items.title: Smooth muscle in the lamina propria: do not exclude it from the mucosa
items.text: The 7 review areas are all vessel walls or muscularis mucosae; in A3 spindle muscle fibres rise between crypts, which COL-10 lists as an exception in diverticular disease (this sample: diverticulitis). Keep COL-10 as an enrich rule only; do not add a smooth-muscle exclusion from the mucosa.

check.reason: All 7 candidate areas were vessel walls or muscularis mucosae on the H&E; a mucosa exclusion would mislabel real muscle in this diverticular-disease sample.
check.evidence: show_area A1-A7: arterial/venous media (A1, A2, A4, A5, A7), muscularis mucosae band (A6), fibres between crypts (A3); COL-10 exception (diverticular disease).

items.title: Interferon-high epithelial patch
items.text: Enterocytes sub-cluster /7 (268 cells) forms one tight patch (spatial clustering 10.7) with IFIT1 99%, RSAD2 95%, DDX58 95% and LAMP3 36%: an interferon response, likely inflamed mucosa near the diverticulitis. It is real biology, not a mislabel; worth a region or a look on the H&E.

check.reason: Not checked on the H&E (location unknown); a tight patch could also be a section or tile artefact, and it does not change the annotation.

items.title: Registration and spill-over fine
items.text: Registration: offset 0 um, max 5.2 um at the corners, no correction needed. Epithelial-marker spill-over falls with distance (59% <10 um, 10% >60 um), the usual segmentation pattern; no tile hotspots of low transcripts.

check.reason: Nothing to act on: registration and spill-over are normal.
